zh-CN.title: 关键事件播报更清晰
items: 空间运营者的任命与取消改为无气泡的系统消息，不再混入普通聊天内容
投稿被要求修改、中止或标记待发布时，投稿者会在与审批者的私聊中看到系统播报

en.title: Clearer event announcements
items: Operator assignments and removals now appear as bubble-free system messages instead of ordinary chat content
Authors receive a system announcement in their direct chat with the reviewer when changes are requested, a submission is closed, or it becomes ready to publish
